```sql
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.Continent = 'Asia' AND h.effective_month = '2026-05' THEN h.population ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
  NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN h.effective_month = '2026-04' THEN h.population ELSE 0 END), 0)
FROM main."country" c
JOIN main."country_history" h ON c.Code = h.code
WHERE h.effective_month IN ('2026-04', '2026-05')
```
